name: Lost in the Sauce
source:
Rumors have it that nothing is as it seems in this place, or at least for some people.

Set in the fictional University of Saustein, you are a new transfer student on your first week. By some luck (or fate?), you stumble upon some of the most gorgeous people you've ever met in your life.

You, dear players, are definitely on for a saucy encounter!

Come to explore a dating sim like nothing you've ever seen! Interact with various characters and figure out what "secrets" are they hiding behind their charms and smiles.

[from [url=https://burakparlak.itch.io/lost-in-the-sauce]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
有传言说，这个地方的一切都不像看上去的那样，至少对某些人来说是这样。

以虚构的索斯坦大学为背景，你是第一周的新转学生。出于某种运气（或命运？），你偶然遇到了一些你一生中遇到过的最美丽的人。

亲爱的玩家们，你们一定会迎来一场俏皮的邂逅！

快来探索前所未见的约会模拟游戏吧！与各种角色互动，找出他们的魅力和微笑背后隐藏着什么“秘密”。

[来自[url=https://burakparlak.itch.io/lost-in-the-sauce]itch.io[/url]]
